note: Per-CVE judgement on which hunk in a bracketed release is the security fix. The diff is mechanical and this file is not: every entry above not_located carries the evidence it rests on, read from the hunks. cve_patch_map.py refuses a located or plausible verdict with no basis.

verdict_meaning.located: The fix hunk is identified and the evidence is stated. A target can be derived from it.
verdict_meaning.plausible: A hunk in the release matches the CWE and the description, and the release carries other CVEs or other work the diff cannot separate from it.
verdict_meaning.not_located: The release was diffed and no hunk in it can be called the fix.
verdict_meaning.unresolved: Not examined, or no tag pair brackets the fix.

CVE-2024-0090.basis: The 535.179..535.183.01, 550.78..550.90.07 and 555.42.02..555.52.04 diffs share two signal-carrying functions. One is kgraphicsCreateBug4208224Channel_TU102, 240 added lines implementing a named hardware workaround channel. The other is _vidmemPmaAllocate, which gained NV_CHECK_OR_RETURN(NV_DIV_AND_CEIL(size, pageSize) <= NV_U32_MAX) before the NvU32 pageCount cast, and replaced pmaInfoSize = sizeof(PMA_ALLOC_INFO) + ((pageCount - 1) * sizeof(NvU64)) with portSafeMulU32 and portSafeAddU32. An undersized PMA_ALLOC_INFO written through pageCount entries is the out-of-bounds write CWE-787 names.
CVE-2024-0090.reachability_note: Reached from video memory allocation with a caller-supplied size and page size: NV_ESC_RM_ALLOC_MEMORY and the NV01_MEMORY_LOCAL_USER class allocation. Both are non-privileged.

CVE-2023-25516.basis: Both bracketed releases, 525.116.04..525.125.06 and 535.43.02..535.54.03, add the identical hunk to kgmmuValidateFabricBaseAddress_GA100 and knvlinkValidateFabricBaseAddress_GV100: fbUpperLimit = fabricBaseAddr + fbSizeBytes becomes portSafeAddU64, under a source comment reading 'Check for integer overflow'. The wrapped sum defeated the following fbUpperLimit > NVBIT64(47) bound, which is the CWE-190 integer overflow the bulletin describes.
CVE-2023-25516.reachability_note: The control method reaching the validator, subdeviceCtrlCmdGpuSetFabricAddr (0x2080016f), carries NON_PRIVILEGED in the NVOC export table, so a flag-based inventory reads it as reachable. Its handler body then calls rmclientIsCapableOrAdmin(NV_RM_CAP_EXT_FABRIC_MGMT) and returns NV_ERR_INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS below that level. A compute,utility container holds no fabric-management capability, so this path is closed to the modelled attacker.

CVE-2025-23277.basis: 535.247.01..535.261.03 and 570.169..570.172.08 share exactly one signal-carrying ioctl-reachable function, nv_dma_buf_map. The hunk drops NV_DMA_BUF_HAS_DYNAMIC_ATTACHMENT from the guard and replaces dma_buf_attachment_is_dynamic(attachment) with attachment->importer_ops != NULL, so the !attachment->peer2peer refusal now runs on kernels where the old predicate was false. A non-coherent platform previously mapped peer MMIO to an importer that had not declared peer2peer support, which is the out-of-permitted-bounds access CWE-284 names.
CVE-2025-23277.reachability_note: The export side is NV_ESC_EXPORT_TO_DMABUF_FD on /dev/nvidiaN, non-privileged. The map side runs when an importer attaches to the exported dma-buf, so a reproducer needs a second device driver importing it, and that is out of reach from ioctls on the NVIDIA nodes alone.

CVE-2024-53869.basis: 535.216.03..535.230.02 sets VM_WIPEONFORK on the semaphore-pool VMA in uvm_vm_open_semaphore_pool. Without it a forked child inherits the parent's semaphore-pool pages, which is the uninitialized-memory leak CWE-459 names, and NVIDIA attributes the CVE to the Unified Memory driver. The other UVM edits in the same release are a PageSwapCache compatibility shim and two flexible-array-member declarations.
CVE-2024-53869.reachability_note: UVM_ALLOC_SEMAPHORE_POOL on /dev/nvidia-uvm, then mmap of the pool range, then fork. The R550 bracket is weaker evidence: 550.142 already carries the same hunk, so the change reached that branch before the release the bulletin names.

CVE-2026-24195.basis: 580.142..580.159.03 and 595.58.03..595.71.05 both change uvm_va_range.c so a UVM_VA_RANGE_TYPE_DEVICE_P2P range is torn down in uvm_va_range_remove_gpu_va_space only when its owning GPU matches the one being unregistered, and both relax the matching UVM_ASSERT in uvm_va_range_unregister_gpu. Tearing down another GPU's P2P range and then asserting on it is a denial of service, which matches CWE-20 and NVIDIA's placement of this CVE in UVM. Bulletin 5821 fixes five kernel-mode CVEs in one release, so the attribution rests on this being the only UVM change among them and on CVE-2026-24195 being the only UVM CVE among them.
CVE-2026-24195.reachability_note: UVM_ALLOC_DEVICE_P2P creates the range. Reaching the hunk needs two registered GPUs in one VA space and an unregister of the one that does not own the range, so a single-GPU instance cannot reproduce it.

CVE-2025-23300.basis: 535.261.03..535.274.02 adds a zero-size rejection in two places on the allocation path: stdmemValidateParams returns NV_ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT when pAllocData->size is 0, and memdescCreate returns the same before the PageCount computation, deleting the branch that previously set PageCount to 0 for a zero allocSize. NVIDIA describes CVE-2025-23300 as a null pointer dereference caused by allocating a specific memory resource, and a zero-size memory descriptor is that resource. Bulletin 5703 fixes four kernel-mode CVEs in this one release, so no diff evidence separates this CVE from the other three.
CVE-2025-23300.reachability_note: NV_ESC_RM_ALLOC_MEMORY and the NVOS32 allocation path with size 0. Non-privileged.

CVE-2025-23332.basis: The same release adds targeted NULL checks on pAdjustedMemDesc->pGpu in dupMemory, under a source comment naming the case: deviceless memory (NV01_MEMORY_DEVICELESS) can have a NULL pGpu, and the IOMMU operations below required a valid GPU context. That is the CWE-476 dereference. The attribution to CVE-2025-23332 over the other three kernel-mode CVEs in bulletin 5703 rests on the CWE and on NVIDIA placing it in a kernel module, and no diff evidence separates them.
CVE-2025-23332.reachability_note: dupMemory is the UVM to RM bridge reached from UVM_MAP_EXTERNAL_ALLOCATION on /dev/nvidia-uvm, with an NV01_MEMORY_DEVICELESS handle allocated over /dev/nvidiactl first.

CVE-2025-23280.basis: The same release moves THREAD_STATE_NODE off the stack in dupMemory, adding threadStateAlloc and a bUsingHeap branch in threadStateFree, and threadStateAlloc warns when a nested init finds a previous node in TLS. A stack-allocated node published into TLS and still referenced after its frame returns is the use-after-free CWE-416 names, and CVE-2025-23280 is the only CWE-416 entry in bulletin 5703. The bulletin fixes four kernel-mode CVEs in one release, so the attribution is not decidable from the diff.
CVE-2025-23280.reachability_note: Same path as CVE-2025-23332: UVM_MAP_EXTERNAL_ALLOCATION reaching dupMemory.

CVE-2025-23282.basis: Bulletin 5703's release carries four kernel-mode CVEs and no hunk in it has the shape of a double free. The nearest candidate, the threadStateAlloc and threadStateFree rework, is the better match for the CWE-416 entry in the same bulletin. Nothing in the diff distinguishes the CWE-415 entry.

CVE-2025-33219.basis: The four bracketed releases share no ioctl-reachable signal-carrying function. The only arithmetic guard in the smallest bracket, 535.274.02..535.288.01, is in gsyncReadUniversalFrameCount_P2060: a NV_CHECK_OR_RETURN on pThis->RefreshRate >= 10 ahead of a division, plus a rescaling of the frame-time expression. That is a genuine arithmetic fix and it matches CWE-190, but it sits behind a P2060 framelock board on the external-device path, which does not match NVIDIA's placement of the CVE in the NVIDIA kernel module, and no other branch corroborates it.

CVE-2025-33221.basis: Bulletin 5821 fixes five kernel-mode CVEs in one release per branch. The 535, 580 and 595 brackets share two signal-carrying functions: fabricvaspaceAllocNonContiguous_IMPL, which gained an explicit NvU32 page-count truncation guard whose source comment reads 'size / pageSize could exceed NvU32 max, causing undersized allocation', and nvidia_ctl_close, which gained a release of a leaked mmap_context allocation. Neither has the shape of CWE-20 incorrect permission assignment, and no other hunk in the release does. Both are recorded as hot spots and neither is attributed to a CVE.

CVE-2023-31018.basis: Bulletin 5491's brackets do not isolate a fix. 525.125.06..525.147.05 carries 50 signal-carrying ioctl-reachable functions and 535.113.01..535.129.03 carries 57; their intersection holds six, spread across nv-p2p, the nvswitch inforom, the Maxwell bus aperture and the MMU walker. The third bracket, 545.29.03..545.29.02, has an empty diff because both tags name the same tree, so it contributes nothing. Both CVEs are CWE-476 and share every bracket, so nothing separates them from each other either.
